findings.title: HOLDS — Overview renders runway/binding-constraint tile per PRD F7-S1
findings.design_ref: PRD F7-S1 first bullet: 'Overview with runway = min()'.
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/runway.ts (new); apps/core/src/routes/read.ts (/status.runway); packages/schema/src/index.ts (RunwayResult zod schema, optional on StatusResponse); apps/web/src/screens/Overview.tsx (RunwayTile spans 2 grid cells).
findings.description:
**Fix commit:** `756db77 GSL-289`. **Live probe:**

```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <scratch>' :7331/status | jq .runway
→ runway.keys = ['hours_left', 'binding', 'live_agents', 'clocks', 'computed_at']
→ clocks.keys = ['context', 'blockers', 'slots']
→ binding = null (no data on scratch DB, honest)
```

The three v1 clocks (context linear-extrapolation with 5-min noise floor, open BLOCKER/permission = 0h hard-cap, slots N/cap informational) are all present. `binding = min-non-null` across clocks; honest `null` when every clock is null (scratch DB has no live sessions with real BLOCKER/permission rows). Overview.tsx imports `RunwayResult` from `@gosleep/schema`, formats `hours_left`, renders `binding` label + per-clock readout — spans 2 grid cells per PRD F7-S1.

findings.title: HOLDS — Fleet model resolved from settings hierarchy; shim-owned fields render honest 'unknown'
findings.design_ref: PRD R7.4 + F7-S1 'card per agent (context %, current tool, cycle, model)'; rev-3 addendum §8.1.

findings.description:
**Fix commit:** `5de47f6 GSL-290`. **Live probe against a booted core reading real tmux sessions:**

```
/fleet.sessions = [
  { name: 'gosleep-93',    model: 'claude-fable-5[1m]', cwd: '.../gosleep', … },
  { name: 'tasty-lunch-2b', model: 'claude-fable-5[1m]', cwd: '.../tasty-lunch', … }
]
```

Model is resolved from the Claude Code settings hierarchy (`<cwd>/.claude/settings.local.json` → `<cwd>/.claude/settings.json` → `~/.claude/settings.json`; top-level `model` → `env.CLAUDE_MODEL` → `env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL`) — both live sessions correctly pick up the owner's `claude-fable-5[1m]` global pin. `context_pct` / `current_tool` / `current_intent` remain `null` on sessions where the PreToolUse shim has not yet fired — the honest 'no data yet' contract per the fix commit: Fleet.tsx renders `"model unknown"` + `"unknown"` pills with tooltips naming the fix (edit settings*.json / install the shim), not blank cells and not fabricated data.

findings.title: HOLDS — /setup Bearer discovery via one-shot OTP; no devtools required
findings.design_ref: target-arch rev 2 §3.3; PRD Phase 7 §Acceptance criteria + end-check.
findings.shipped_ref: apps/core/src/routes/setup.ts (new); OtpStore stores sha256(otp) in memory only, gc on create, 5-min TTL clamped [30, 3600]s, internal-secret gated. apps/web/src/data/auth.ts consumes <meta name='gosleep-token'>; apps/web/src/main.tsx boot-time getBearer(). plist.sh setup-url subcommand mints the URL.
findings.description:
**Fix commit:** `2f89663 GSL-291`. **Live probe end-to-end:**

```
POST /internal/setup/otp (X-Internal-Secret + Origin=:7331) → 200
  body { ok:true, otp:'b98a2059…', url:'…/setup?tok=…', expires_at:'…', ttl_s:300 }
GET /setup?tok=<otp>                                        → 200 text/html
  <meta name="gosleep-token" content="verify-run02-token-DO-NOT-USE">
  Cache-Control: no-store, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
GET /setup?tok=<same-otp> (replay)                          → 400 (single-use)
POST /internal/setup/otp (no secret)                        → 401
POST /internal/setup/otp (X-Internal-Secret + wrong Origin) → 403
```

Bearer never appears in URL, history, or Referer; it is delivered exactly once inside the meta tag, which `auth.ts` reads and then removes from the DOM. All five smoke lanes match the fix commit's own scenarios 59-66.
findings.technique: hermetic core boot + full OTP-mint → /setup → replay → no-secret → wrong-origin curl transcript

architecture_notes.title: Score arithmetic: how run 01's 42 became run 02's 100
architecture_notes.body:
Run 01 counted 4 CRITICAL + 5 MAJOR + 2 MINOR = 11 findings against the Phase 7 acceptance criteria then in force. Since then:

- **7 landed as fixes** (GSL-285/289/290/291/293/294/295) — each individually verified above.
- **4 moved out of Phase 7** (GSL-286/287/288/292) — owner decision `d-2026-08-08-002` re-parented them to GSL-174 (skills-management epic) after the GSL-174 prerequisites (`tools/skills/publish.sh` + `docs/skills/CHANGELOG.jsonl`) were postponed. The PRD carries a dedicated section documenting this; every re-parented ticket has `moved-from-GSL-250` + `rescope-2026-08-08` labels; the rescope commit (GSL-296) annotates the PR body.

Against the POST-rescope Phase 7 acceptance criteria, zero findings remain.

architecture_notes.title: What was NOT re-verified in this run (out of scope)
architecture_notes.body:
This is the fix-confirmation lane, so it does not re-audit the epic from scratch. It does not enumerate NEW findings; that is the job of a fresh independent verifier if the owner wants one. Concretely:

- The 4 moved tickets are scope-checked (PRD section + Jira parent + labels), not code-checked — their code observations from run 01 remain accurate as historical baseline.
- `core-smoke.sh` was not re-run against 0919aab in this session (would double-boot port 7331). The fix commits report 89/89 PASS; independent verification would use `bash tools/lab/tests/core-smoke.sh` after this run's server was killed.
- The web bundle is real (`apps/web/dist/index-CFx6demg.css`, `.js`, Geist woff2 fonts all present) and serves via the new SPA route, but visual pixel-perfect rendering was verified from source (Overview.tsx spans 2 grid cells for RunwayTile; Fleet.tsx renders unknown pills; globals.css h1..h6 = 500) rather than by rendering the browser — no new screenshots were captured in this run, and the assets carried over from run 01 label their baseline explicitly.
